title: The Case of the Solitary Resident
author: thesleuthacademy
description:
"Police? I hope I'm not wasting your time, but I'm genuinely concerned. There's this weird, awful smell coming from my neighbour's apartment, and I haven't seen her around for days. It's starting to feel really unsettling... I think something might be seriously wrong."

Uncover the truth behind a mysterious death in an apartment. Search for clues, gather evidence, interview suspects and find the culprit. Seems like it's just another day in the life of a detective... or is it?

Chances are you might learn something new along the way.

Another classic whodunnit by thesleuthacademy.
